tasks.label: js-paren-balance-check
args:
python -c "
import re
from pathlib import Path

def check_js_parens(path):
    text = Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    depth = 0
    in_str1 = in_str2 = in_bt = False
    prev = ''
    for i, ch in enumerate(text):
        if ch == '\"' and not in_str1 and not in_bt and prev != '\\': in_str2 = not in_str2
        elif ch == \"'\" and not in_str2 and not in_bt and prev != '\\': in_str1 = not in_str1
        elif ch == '`' and not in_str1 and not in_str2: in_bt = not in_bt
        elif not in_str1 and not in_str2 and not in_bt:
            if ch == '(': depth += 1
            elif ch == ')': depth -= 1
        prev = ch
    return depth

js_files = ['app/static/calendar.ui.js', 'app/static/calendar.js', 'app/static/calendar.fullcalendar.js']
for f in js_files:
    d = check_js_parens(f)
    print(f, 'unmatched parens:', d)
"
